baseline.derivedFrom: Explore agent codebase scan (functions/index.js, firmware/receiver/receiver.ino, firmware/sender/sender.ino, lib/views/dev_config_page.dart) at commit 9a7c48e

claims.claim: POST /lora-uplink requires X-Receiver-Id/X-Receiver-Credential headers verified via SHA-256 against receivers/{id}/private/credential.credentialVerifier
Body fields consumed: helmetId (required), lat, lng, alt, speed, heading, battery, rssi, snr, satellites (all optional numeric with defaults)
status is derived only as speed===0 ? 'idle' : 'active'; no SOS path exists in /lora-uplink
Real sender firmware transmits every TX_INTERVAL_S=10 seconds
sender.ino contains a fake-GPS random-walk generator stepFakeGps() (heading jitter + constant speed) used when USE_REAL_GPS is false
helmetExists() only requires prior provisioning via /admin/helmets/provision; claimed status is irrelevant to ingestion
No staging Firebase project exists; only production smhelmet-67 / helix-webhook.onrender.com are deployed
A prior simulator/ existed (Python http.server + static Leaflet index.html, single shared X-Webhook-Token auth, single helmet) and was deleted in commit f9492d2
claims.evidence: git show f9492d2 --stat -- simulator/; git show f9492d2^:simulator/README.md
